expectations.text: The output does not fill Learn with an arbitrary docs page chosen only to fill the section.
expectations.evidence: Row #6, 'Docs pages added to pad Learn', is marked **cut** because it fails the window gate and has 'no dated trigger inside the window'. The thin-issue call drops Learn under the empty-section rule instead of filling it. The output says a docs page can return only with a dated in-window trigger, a charter-named evergreen slot, or counted demand signals ('docs searches returning nothing, or the same question asked three or more times'). It calls docs search logs and support questions 'the legitimate way to fill Learn'. No arbitrary docs page is added anywhere.
